predeclaredReadout.longReasoning: First reasoning arrives promptly; events continue and first answer or full completion exceeds original 300-second deadline.
predeclaredReadout.transportOrQueue: Record response-header/first-event delays, event gaps and error; no inference that a long gap alone proves network responsibility.
predeclaredReadout.repetition: Inspect full local reasoning for repeated calculations/planning; describe at high level without quoting raw reasoning.
predeclaredReadout.nonReproduction: If completion within 300 seconds, retain as non-reproduction rather than proof the original failure is fixed.

qualityScope: Execution diagnosis only; no evaluator accuracy, candidate selection or quality improvement claim. Any answer observations are source-checked diagnostic notes.
limits: Historical nonstream provider activity cannot be recovered by a new sample.
Python streaming 600-second execution differs from historical Java nonstream 300-second execution.
One sample per case; same model name does not guarantee immutable provider revision.
